title: "`r {source('_setup.R'); tr('cran.title')}`"

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
## CRAN (SPEC.md S7.1): status by package and flavour, the daily download
## series with vertical release markers, and the permanent version history.
##
## SPEC.md S7.2 is enforced here twice over: every download figure carries
## the mandatory "partial sample" label and a one-click link to the S10.1
## limitation, and every figure is dated by its own most recent datum
## (cran_downloads.json -> latest_data_date), never by the build time.
source("_setup.R")

status_json <- zb_json("cran_status")
downloads_json <- zb_json("cran_downloads")

status <- zb_df(status_json$status)
checks <- zb_df(status_json$checks)
versions <- zb_df(status_json$versions)
flavors <- status_json$flavors

daily <- zb_points(downloads_json$series, "package")
releases <- zb_df(downloads_json$releases)
monthly <- zb_df(downloads_json$monthly)
series <- zb_df(downloads_json$series)
downloads_date <- zb_get(downloads_json, "latest_data_date")
```

```{r}
#| label: header
#| results: asis
zb_out(zb_page_header("cran.html", downloads_date))
```

`r tr("cran.lead")`

## `r tr("cran.status.title")`

```{r}
#| label: status
#| results: asis
if (nrow(status) == 0L) {
  zb_out(zb_no_data(tr("cran.status.none")))
} else {
  status <- status[order(status$package), , drop = FALSE]
  table <- data.frame(
    package = status$package,
    worst = zb_status(status$worst_status),
    n_flavors = zb_int(status$n_flavors),
    n_not_ok = zb_int(status$n_flavors_not_ok),
    on_cran = zb_bool(status$on_cran),
    archived = zb_bool(status$archived),
    maintainer = status$maintainer,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  zb_out(zb_table(
    table,
    labels = c(
      tr("common.package"), tr("cran.col.worst_status"),
      tr("cran.col.n_flavors"), tr("cran.col.n_flavors_not_ok"),
      tr("cran.col.on_cran"), tr("cran.col.archived"),
      tr("cran.col.maintainer")
    ),
    caption = tr_f("common.snapshot_date",
      date = zb_date(zb_get(status_json, "snapshot_date"))
    ),
    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "l", "l", "l"),
    raw = "worst",
    row_header = TRUE
  ))
}
```

## `r tr("cran.checks.title")`

`r tr("cran.checks.lead")`

```{r}
#| label: checks-matrix
#| results: asis
if (nrow(checks) == 0L || !length(flavors)) {
  zb_out(zb_no_data(tr("cran.checks.none")))
} else {
  packages <- sort(unique(checks$package))
  # Flavours are the rows and packages the columns: CRAN runs a dozen or more
  # flavours against a handful of packages, so this orientation fits the page
  # instead of forcing a thirteen-column scroll. Flavour names are CRAN
  # identifiers, hence data, and are printed verbatim.
  matrix_df <- data.frame(flavor = flavors, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (pkg in packages) {
    matrix_df[[pkg]] <- vapply(flavors, function(flavor) {
      hit <- checks$status[checks$package == pkg & checks$flavor == flavor]
      zb_status(if (length(hit)) hit[[1L]] else NA_character_)
    }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  }
  zb_out(zb_table(
    matrix_df,
    labels = c(tr("cran.col.flavor"), packages),
    caption = tr_f("common.snapshot_date",
      date = zb_date(zb_get(status_json, "snapshot_date"))
    ),
    align = c("l", rep("c", length(packages))),
    raw = packages,
    row_header = TRUE
  ))

  times <- checks[!is.na(checks$check_time), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(times) > 0L) {
    summary_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(times, times$package), function(g) {
      data.frame(
        package = g$package[[1L]],
        version = g$version[[1L]],
        check_time = zb_dbl(stats::median(g$check_time), digits = 1L),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }))
    zb_out(zb_table(
      summary_df,
      labels = c(tr("common.package"), tr("common.version"), tr("cran.col.check_time")),
      caption = tr("cran.col.check_time"),
      align = c("l", "l", "r"),
      row_header = TRUE
    ))
  }
}
```

## `r tr("cran.downloads.title")`

```{r}
#| label: downloads-note
#| results: asis
zb_out(zb_downloads_note("lim-1"))
```

```{r}
#| label: downloads-daily
#| results: asis
if (nrow(daily) == 0L) {
  zb_out(zb_no_data(tr("cran.downloads.none")))
} else {
  markers <- releases[!is.na(releases$date), , drop = FALSE]
  markers$date <- as.Date(markers$date)
  markers <- markers[
    markers$date >= min(daily$date) & markers$date <= max(daily$date), ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  plot <- ggplot(daily, aes(x = date, y = downloads))

  # Release markers exist to make the rebuild artefact visible, never to
  # correct it (SPEC.md S10.3).
  if (nrow(markers) > 0L) {
    plot <- plot + geom_vline(
      data = markers, aes(xintercept = date),
      linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.45, colour = "#8a1420"
    )
  }

  plot <- plot +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.55, colour = zb_palette[[1L]]) +
    facet_wrap(~package, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    zb_scale_x_day() +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
    labs(x = tr("cran.downloads.axis_x"), y = tr("cran.downloads.axis_y")) +
    zb_theme()

  zb_out(zb_fig(
    plot,
    alt = tr_f("cran.downloads.alt", date = zb_date(downloads_date)),
    caption = paste0(
      zb_chart_dateline(downloads_date), " ",
      tr_f("downloads.window",
        start = zb_date(zb_get(downloads_json, "window_start")),
        end = zb_date(zb_get(downloads_json, "window_end"))
      )
    ),
    height = zb_facet_height(length(unique(daily$package)), per = 1.7, base = 1.2)
  ))
  zb_out(zb_note(tr("cran.downloads.markers")))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: downloads-summary

if (nrow(series) > 0L) {
  series <- series[order(series$package), , drop = FALSE]
  table <- data.frame(

    labels = c(tr("common.package"), tr("cran.col.downloads")),
    caption = paste0(
      tr("cran.downloads.summary_title"), " — ", tr("downloads.label")
    ),
    align = c("l", "r"),
    row_header = TRUE
  ))
}
```

## `r tr("cran.monthly.title")`

`r tr("cran.monthly.lead")`

```{r}
#| label: downloads-monthly
#| results: asis
if (nrow(monthly) == 0L) {
  zb_out(zb_no_data(tr("cran.monthly.none")))
} else {
  zb_out(zb_downloads_note("lim-1"))
  monthly$month_date <- as.Date(paste0(monthly$month, "-01"))
  latest_month <- max(monthly$month)

  plot <- ggplot(monthly, aes(x = month_date, y = downloads, fill = package)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single"), width = 22) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = zb_palette) +
    scale_x_date(labels = function(d) zb_month(format(d, "%Y-%m"))) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
    labs(x = tr("common.month"), y = tr("cran.monthly.axis_y")) +
    zb_theme()

  zb_out(zb_fig(
    plot,
    alt = tr_f("cran.monthly.alt", date = zb_month(latest_month)),
    caption = zb_chart_dateline(paste0(latest_month, "-01")),
    height = 3.6
  ))

  wide <- monthly[order(monthly$month, monthly$package), c("month", "package", "downloads")]
  table <- data.frame(
    month = zb_month(wide$month),
    package = wide$package,
    downloads = zb_int(wide$downloads),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  zb_out(zb_table(
    table,
    labels = c(tr("common.month"), tr("common.package"), tr("cran.col.downloads")),
    caption = paste0(tr("cran.monthly.title"), " — ", tr("downloads.label")),
    align = c("l", "l", "r")
  ))
}
```
